delay.description: Delay in seconds between updates (corresponds to 'delay' argument in CLI).

count.description: Number of iterations to display (0 means infinite). (corresponds to 'count' argument in CLI).

host.description: Database server host or socket directory (corresponds to -h).

user.description: Connect as specified database user (corresponds to -U).

stat.description: Stats to collect (e.g., bgwriter, database, table, tableio, index, function, statement, replication slots, slru, wal, etc.). (corresponds to -s).

substat.description: Part of stats to display (only works for database and statement). (corresponds to -S).

filter.description: Include only this object (only works for database, table, tableio, index, function, statement statistics, replication slots, and slru). (corresponds to -f).

filter_objects.description: List of filter objects to include if using -f.
